_doc: BLUELINE — board records for the 6-shot opening. The reproducible generative truth behind each board, keyed by shot id, so the Ableton clip NAMES can stay short (carry just a gist) while the full prompt+negative+seed live here. Aligns with BLUELINE — Board Record Schema (POSITIVE / NEG / SEED / SHOT_ID). The clip's POSITION+LENGTH carries time; this file carries content. Prompts extracted verbatim from render_shot.py SHOTS (feature/blueline-m3); style/neg from style-lock/locked-style.json (pen-flow, locked 2026-06-19).
style_lock: modern pen and ink illustration, loose gestural linework with bold dramatic sweeping flow lines and speed streaks driving the motion, scattered energetic ink blobs and splatter, stark high-contrast black and white, film-noir deep shadow, rough white paper, lots of white space, dynamic foreshortening, low canted angle
negative: extra limbs, deformed, two heads, color, colour, photograph, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth digital shading, gradient, blurry, low quality, watermark, text, signature, frame, border, static, stiff, standing still, posed portrait, symmetrical, calm, motionless, bust shot

boards.clip_name: 01 · noir city, many rooftop fires, high wide, smoke
boards.positive: a vast sprawling noir city at night seen from a high wide angle, many separate fires burning across distant rooftops, thick billowing smoke rising, a brooding skyline, desolate, cinematic high-contrast
boards.seed_note: keeper filename carries no seed suffix; reseed if re-rendering

boards.clip_name: 02 · figure on crushed sedan roof, arm out pointing, embers
boards.positive: a lone powerful figure standing on the crushed dented roof of a burning sedan, one arm thrust out pointing a finger at a sparse frightened crowd, commanding, smoke and embers
boards.pose: authored (Track IV openpose) — standing on roof, pointing

boards.clip_name: 03 · CU braced legs explode upward, car roof buckling, debris
boards.positive: tight close-up on a figure's braced legs and boots exploding upward into a jump, the steel car roof buckling and denting downward under the impossible force, debris flying
boards.seed_note: keeper filename carries no seed suffix; reseed if re-rendering

boards.clip_name: 04 · worm's-eye, figure plummeting at camera, coat flaring, fire sky
boards.positive: extreme low angle from the ground looking straight up, a figure plummeting downward fast toward the viewer, long coat flaring violently, against a smoke-and-fire sky

boards.clip_name: 05 · hard crouch landing, radial pavement crack, woman's body, crowd recoiling
boards.positive: a figure landing hard in a low crouch on cracked asphalt, the pavement shattering in a radial ring around him, smoke and dust blasting outward from the impact, a woman's limp body on the ground nearby, a crowd recoiling in the back
boards.pose: authored (hero behind, woman front) — layered composite
boards.seed_note: keeper = rich_final_d85.png, the rich-first/stylize-last LAYERED build (separate hero+woman+crowd layer-prompts -> integrate pass -> desaturate + img2img denoise 0.85). Not a single-seed render; the line above is the canonical one-liner. See new-story/layer_render.py + rich_pipeline.py to reproduce.

boards.clip_name: 06 · POV straight down at dying woman's face, blood/sweat falling, kiss off-frame
boards.positive: extreme close-up of a dying woman's face seen from directly above, the grieving hero's point of view looking straight down at her, her head tilted back on the ground, eyes closed, lips parted, hair splayed out, drops of blood and sweat falling down toward her face from above, raw anguish, the unseen kiss just out of frame
boards.reframe_note: the two-figure kiss was the multi-subject hard case; reframed to the hero's POV (one expressive face) — the kiss is the unseen thing past the bottom edge
